title: TIME JUMP — 08:00: Stores Opening, Counts Still Open

fields.narration: It is now 08:00 Pacific Time, Tuesday, October 12, 2027. The fog over Salinas is starting to thin. CDPH has reported three illnesses, and whole-genome sequencing is still pending. FDA's records request has been in the inbox since 07:34. Within the next hour, Harvest Table, Westline and Cornerstone stores open with Pinecrest romaine on the shelves. At 07:56 the Recall Team share received a new draft reconciliation table, REV B. The MES and the destination totals now agree at 38,600 cases. The table also has a Gaps tab that nobody can close yet. Only Stockton and Phoenix have physically confirmed their holds. Dallas has confirmed its hold in the system only, and a trailer is still on the road. The lab's confirmation is 22 to 46 hours away. The draft press release that says 'about 40,000 cases' is still in the shared folder. You have to decide before the facts are confirmed.
worldState: Clock: 08:00 PT, Tuesday, October 12, 2027. Line 2 at Plant 1 is still down for the swab series.
Reconciliation table REV B (Recall Team share, saved 07:56): MES total 38,600 cases across PF1-27277-L2-B, PF1-27278-L2-A, PF1-27278-L2-B, PF1-27279-L2-A and PF1-27279-L2-B.
REV B by destination: Stockton DC 18,900, Phoenix DC 9,700, Dallas DC 7,400 and Rivermark Kits 2,600, for a total of 38,600.
REV B Gaps tab: 60 cases are in the MES but missing from the WMS, cause unknown. Another 104 Rivermark cases cannot be matched to a full lot code from the paper receiving records.
Stockton DC: 11,340 cases physically segregated, tagged and counted. 7,560 shipped to Harvest Table and Westline before the hold.
Phoenix DC: 5,820 cases physically segregated, tagged and counted. 3,880 shipped before the hold.
Dallas DC: 3,000 cases are held in the WMS but not physically confirmed (Dallas says it can confirm by 10:30), and 3,080 cases have shipped to 38 Cornerstone stores.
The Sonoran Cold Freight trailer with 1,320 cases is still heading east on I-10 past Tucson. Its ETA in Dallas is about 21:00.
CDPH has requested a ship-to distribution list. FDA has requested an electronic sortable spreadsheet for the five lots and incoming lot FLD-SLG-R14-C-27277. Neither has been sent.
Coastal Analytical Labs expects cultural confirmation in 22 to 46 hours.
Pinecrest_Recall_PressRelease_DRAFT_v3.docx ('about 40,000 cases') is still in the shared Recall Team folder, editable and forwardable. Harvest Table has already received a copy.
fields.facilitatorNote: Watch whether every seat now quotes REV B (38,600) and nobody uses 'about 40,000'. TRACE should keep the 60 and 104 cases listed in the Gaps tab as unaccounted for, not round them away. RECALL should prepare to brief the President. COMMS should remove or lock the leaked draft. If Dallas's unconfirmed 3,000 and the trailer on I-10 go unmentioned, ask LOG who owns them.

instructorNote: This card resets everyone to one set of numbers (REV B) before the recall decision. Watch that TRACE keeps the 60 MES-not-in-WMS cases and the 104 unmatched Rivermark cases marked as unaccounted for, that RECALL prepares to brief the President, and that COMMS locks or removes the 'about 40,000' draft so it can't be forwarded again.

citations.documentTitle: PFC-FS-04: Recall Notification, Regulatory Contact and Public Statements
citations.headingPath: PFC-FS-04: Recall Notification,… › 4. Counts that must reconcile
citations.quote: Every letter and release states quantities from the reconciliation table. The total of cases shipped to all customers equals the total of cases produced for the affected lots, less cases held at Pinec

citations.documentTitle: PFC-OPS-02: Plant, Distribution Network and Cold Chain
citations.quote: Pinecrest uses two truckload carriers (Cascade Reefer Lines and Sonoran Cold Freight, both fictional) with refrigerated trailers that carry a temperature recorder; a reefer trailer carries 22 pallets

citations.documentTitle: PFC-QA-03: Lot Coding and Traceability Records
citations.quote: A reconciliation table is kept for every incident: cases produced, shipped to each DC, shipped by each DC to each customer, held at each location, delivered to stores, returned, destroyed, unaccounted

citations.documentTitle: PFC-QA-03: Lot Coding and Traceability Records
citations.quote: The Traceability and Systems Lead produces one sortable spreadsheet with these columns: lot code, product, quantity and unit (cases), ship date, ship-from location, ship-to customer, ship-to location
